Corn Beef Hash
By: Anonymous
Published: Thursday, December 17, 2009 - 11:20pm

Ingredients




Whole corned beef round - boiled
6 potatoes, boiled and mashed up
2 onions
Dried parsley to taste
Salt and pepper to taste

Preparation

1 Boil beef covered with water until tender with fork. Boil potatoes in same water. Mash potatoes and let cool in large bowl. Mince up onion. Mince up beef. Mix all the ingredients together. Fry up as wanted.
